command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: create opsadmin user"
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
  passwd -l opsadmin >/dev/null
fi
id opsadmin

echo "STEP: create temp low-priv test user"
if ! id crontest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd -m -s /bin/bash crontest
  passwd -l crontest >/dev/null
fi
id crontest

echo "STEP: write /etc/cron.allow"
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' > /etc/cron.allow
chown root:root /etc/cron.allow
chmod 644 /etc/cron.allow
cat /etc/cron.allow

echo "STEP: remove stray cron.deny if present (allow list takes precedence but keep clean)"
rm -f /etc/cron.deny

echo "STEP: verify root can use cron"
crontab -l 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: verify opsadmin can use cron"
su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'crontab -l' 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: verify crontest is denied"
su -s /bin/sh crontest -c 'crontab -l' 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: verify opsadmin can actually install a cron job"
su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -' 2>&1
su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'crontab -l' 2>&1

echo "STEP: verify crontest cannot install a cron job"
su -s /bin/sh crontest -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -' 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: cleanup opsadmin crontab (avoid leaving stray job) - keep user, remove job"
su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'crontab -r' 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: cleanup temp test user"
userdel -r crontest 2>&1 || true

echo "DONE"
